checks.why: A VERIFIED claim must not have source_status=LLM_OUTPUT.
All VERIFIED claims carry a non-empty source field.
All VERIFIED claims carry at least one source-span evidence record. (Receipt-linkage sub-check is SKIPPED_UNSUPPORTED — no global receipt registry.)
No global receipt registry in L3. Use 'velantrim verify-receipt <file>' to replay individual receipts.
Audit log captures compliance events (erase/restrict) but not L3 write events. Structural enforcement is provided by TruthGate and Guardian at write time.

issues.suggestion: Demote to UNVERIFIED or attach external evidence and review.
